Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, around 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “Done everything right”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do so many high achievers feel stuck, even when life looks great on paper?”

Body

“As a doctor, here’s what I find fascinating. The brain is built to repeat what’s familiar. So you can set the goal, make the plan, and still end up back in the same place. Not because something is wrong with you, but because the old pattern is the one you’ve practised most.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how to start shifting that pattern in a live masterclass called Rewire to Receive. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera in your white coat, simple background.

Script 2 · “The whiteboard”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“3 things to understand before you try to manifest anything.”

Body

“One: your beliefs shape what you go after. Two: repeated thoughts become your default. Three: new patterns are built with small daily practice, not one big breakthrough. Most people skip straight to the vision board and wonder why nothing sticks.”

CTA

“I go deeper on all three in Rewire to Receive, my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: same whiteboard setup as your “3 things to do before you…” post.

Script 3 · “Allowed to want more”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Wanting more and feeling guilty about it is more common than you think.”

Body

“A lot of the high achievers I talk to are proud of what they’ve built, and still feel there’s more for them. Then a quiet voice asks if they’re allowed. In my masterclass we look at where that voice comes from, and a simple practice to start answering it differently.”

CTA

“Rewire to Receive is live, $17, with the replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: relaxed selfie-style video at home, warm light.
